info.name: Go Web API - Frontend Integration
info.description:
# Go Web API - Frontend Integration Collection

## Quick Setup

1. **Login** — run `Auth > Login` to get tokens (auto-saved to environment)
2. **List My Tenants** — run `Tenants > List My Tenants` to auto-save your `tenant_slug`
3. **Start making business requests** — Inventory, Sales, Purchasing, and Tracking are ready

## Auth

Collection-level bearer auth uses `{{token}}`. Requests that do not need auth (Login, Register, OTP) explicitly set `noauth`.

## X-Tenant-Slug

All requests in the Inventory, Sales, Purchasing, and Tracking folders include the `X-Tenant-Slug: {{tenant_slug}}` header automatically. Set `tenant_slug` by running `List My Tenants` or set it manually.

## Folder Organization

- **Auth** — Login, Register, Profile, Tokens, OTP
- **Users** — Admin user management
- **Tenants** — Multi-tenant management (no X-Tenant-Slug needed)
- **Inventory** — Products, Categories, Batches, Stock movements
- **Sales** — Customers, Orders, Returns, Payments, Reports
- **Purchasing** — Suppliers, Purchase Orders
- **Tracking** — Transport Companies, Vehicles
